frage: How do I get to the Gasterntal by car?
antwort: Via a gravel road (14 km) from Kandersteg; the road is subject to a fee. Through the Chluse you can drive up from a quarter to until five past each hour, and passing is not possible there. The permit goes on the windscreen; you can buy it at the hotel.
